name: University of Liverpool
description:
The University of Liverpool was founded as a college in 1881 before gaining Royal Charter as a university in 1903, making it the Original Red Brick university. The worldâ€™s first public radio transmission was made by a professor at the university in 1894. It was a founding member of the Russell Group and the N8 Group for research and its management school has been triple crown accredited.

It is in the QS Top 200 Global Universities as well as the top 25 UK universities in the Complete University Guide and The Times/Sunday Times Guide. There are more than 22,000 students at the University of Liverpool including 7,700 international students from more than 160 countries. They can choose from more than 400 undergraduate and postgraduate courses.

What is the University Of Liverpool acceptance rate for international students?

The University of Liverpool acceptance rate is 14%.

The University of Liverpool is a highly ranked British university that has received a lot of investment into reflecting their reputation via their facilities. The Guild of Students is the student union building and it has recently benefited from a Â£14.25 million redevelopment so it is now a highly equipped environment. The Harold Cohen Library is the University of Liverpool's library, situated on the north part of the city centre campus. Students working towards degrees within the Faculty of Science & Engineering and the Faculty of Health & Life Sciences can find resources here.

Student Life

Student life at the University of Liverpool is reported highly by students. International students can refer to the International Advice and Guidance team or benefit from free in-sessional English language support throughout your studies provided by the campus based English Language Centre. More than 50 student clubs are run by students on campus, from the anime society to the karaoke society - and even the Taylor Swift Appreciation society. The Times Good University Guide nominated the University of Liverpool for its 'University of the Year 2024â€™ award.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
The University of Liverpool is a top-tier university located in the lively and vibrant city of Liverpool, in the northwest of England. With a history dating back to 1881, this prestigious institution is part of Russell Group’s research-intensive universities.

The University of Liverpool ranking is consistently high, and is ranked among the top universities in the UK, offering a high-quality education with a strong emphasis on research and innovation. The University of Liverpool acceptance rate is also highly competitive, making it an ideal choice for students aspiring to study at a prestigious institution. Plus, they've earned TEF Gold recognition for their commitment to excellent teaching.

highlights.title: Student Life
highlights.value:
With over 25,000 students on the campus, you’ll be in a multicultural environment, getting a truly global perspective. The Liverpool Guild of Students is the heart of student life on campus, offering you over 200 clubs and societies.

Whether you're into gaming, or music, or just want to make new friends, there’s something for everyone. And if you’re into sports, the University’s Athletic Union runs more than 40 sports clubs that you can join – from football and rugby, tennis, fencing, and many more.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
The University of Liverpool offers a range of housing options, with over 4400 student rooms. The rooms are modern, well-equipped, and conveniently close to campus facilities. Whether you prefer a shared room or a private studio, you get options to suit your budget and needs.

The university's Student Housing Service assists you in finding suitable off-campus accommodations, including private rented housing or shared flats.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The university’s library is filled with resources to help you with your studies. You can access several journals, e-resources, use quiet spaces and study rooms for focused work.

Sports
If you’re into sports, you’ll love the University’s excellent sports facilities. The Sports and Fitness Centre has everything you need to stay fit, from gyms and fitness classes to sports courts and swimming pools.

Laboratory
The University is home to some amazing research labs across various disciplines, from medical sciences to engineering and environmental studies.

Cafeteria
The campus has plenty of food options. From cafes and food courts to different spots offering international dishes, you’ll always find someplace to eat at the University.
